name: g2_singles_lpqi_pathfinder
label: Bright northern O/B stars with theta = 0.2-0.4 mas on the LPQI-Pathfinder: diameters from the nightly null crossing
notes: Stars whose first null (1.22 lambda/theta = 300-400 m at 500 nm) the Pathfinder's 300-530 m nightly baseline sweep crosses: the null position gives the diameter nearly model-independently. None has an interferometric diameter.
NewEra covers nothing above 12 000 K, so the stars are blackbodies with the Spica linear law; the V anchor sets the flux.
